notes.title: Monster rage in HexaMon!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25784658/65e79f84f7d9a5999a4532fb2a143400789d00e8.jpg[/img]

[b]Group four identical monsters [/b]so they merge to become a stronger monster. Don’t be fooled by how easy it looks – each level is trickier than the last. 
[list]
[*]35 thrilling levels 
[*]More than 1000 levels in free mode 
[*]Cute monsters infront of hand painted backdrops 
[*]Tons of objectives 
[*]Lively music for a cheerful mood 
[/list]
http://store.steampowered.com/app/743480/HexaMon/

notes.title: Passage 4 - Easter Update
notes.content:
Now you can enjoy Passage 4 in an Easter environment. 
Additional Easter content has been added to the game:
- background
- music
- stone set

Happy Easter!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27104860/609155dda65e359244f9b6cda815ad39d261ab24.jpg[/img]
